notes: scores are after extra time and exclude penalty shoot-outs (upstream definition)
kick-off times are not in the source; ordering within a day follows upstream row order

source.dataset: International football results from 1872 (men's senior full internationals)
source.score_definition: Full-time score including extra time, excluding penalty shoot-outs.
source.notes: Files are stored byte-for-byte as downloaded. To refresh, follow docs/ml/ML_PIPELINE_V3.md (replace the files, update this record, re-run the training workflow); a refresh changes the corpus fingerprint recorded in every model manifest.

feature_registry.name: elo_diff_venue
feature_registry.definition: Elo(A) - Elo(B) + home advantage x venue
feature_registry.available: before kick-off (uses matches strictly earlier in the chronological walk)
feature_registry.leakage_risk: none: rating is read before the update

feature_registry.name: elo_diff
feature_registry.available: before kick-off (uses matches strictly earlier in the chronological walk)

feature_registry.name: venue
feature_registry.definition: +1 A at home, 0 neutral, -1 B at home
feature_registry.available: known when the fixture is set

feature_registry.name: log_xg_ratio
feature_registry.definition: log(expected goals A / expected goals B) from online Poisson
feature_registry.available: before kick-off (uses matches strictly earlier in the chronological walk)

feature_registry.name: log_xg_total
feature_registry.available: before kick-off (uses matches strictly earlier in the chronological walk)

feature_registry.name: form_pts_diff
feature_registry.definition: exp-weighted points per match, A - B (half-life 8 matches)
feature_registry.available: before kick-off (uses matches strictly earlier in the chronological walk)

feature_registry.name: form_gd_diff
feature_registry.definition: exp-weighted goal difference per match, A - B
feature_registry.available: before kick-off (uses matches strictly earlier in the chronological walk)

feature_registry.name: momentum_diff
feature_registry.definition: Elo change over each team's last 10 matches, A - B
feature_registry.available: before kick-off (uses matches strictly earlier in the chronological walk)

feature_registry.name: rest_days_diff
feature_registry.definition: days since last match (capped 365), A - B
feature_registry.available: before kick-off (uses matches strictly earlier in the chronological walk)

feature_registry.name: activity_diff
feature_registry.definition: matches played in the previous 365 days, A - B
feature_registry.available: before kick-off (uses matches strictly earlier in the chronological walk)

feature_registry.name: h2h_gd_shrunk
feature_registry.available: before kick-off (uses matches strictly earlier in the chronological walk)

feature_registry.name: exp_min
feature_registry.definition: min(log1p matches played A, B): how well-rated the weaker-known side is
feature_registry.available: before kick-off (uses matches strictly earlier in the chronological walk)

feature_registry.name: abs_elo_diff
feature_registry.available: before kick-off (uses matches strictly earlier in the chronological walk)

feature_registry.name: tier
feature_registry.available: known when the fixture is set
